name: ps6o (custom CIS 731 ontology)

classes.Document: An admitted MP5 record (ASR transcript segment or VDB text). Key: doc_id.
classes.Chunk: A character span of one Document; the unit of retrieval. Key: record_id.
classes.Embedding: The vector for one Chunk from one model. Stored inside the chunk's record.
classes.EmbeddingModel: The encoder that produced the vector: model_id + model_revision.

granularity: Chunk is the main unit because retrieval and relevance judging both happen per chunk.
Spans are character offsets, not token offsets, so they stay valid if the tokenizer or model changes.
Embedding is a separate class but stored in the chunk record, because the project uses one model; a second model would become a second record per chunk.
No Section class: MP5 records are at most 30 seconds (1-2 sentences), so they have no internal structure to model.
